themes.description: Users report that cashback rewards advertised for bill and UPI payments are either not credited, are unavailable, or redirect them to US stock purchase pages. The app requires creation of a US stock account and a minimum investment to claim cashback, which contradicts earlier claims that cashback could be earned on any bill payment.
themes.business_impact: Loss of transaction volume in the bill‑payment segment, erosion of customer trust leading to churn among high‑spend users, negative brand perception affecting acquisition, and potential regulatory or legal scrutiny over misleading reward practices.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The reward redemption flow was altered to funnel users into US stock purchases, possibly due to a partnership or compliance requirement, but the UI/UX and backend logic were not updated to reflect this change, causing redirect bugs and eligibility miscalculations.
themes.action_plan:
• Revert to original cashback flow
• Separate US stock account creation from cashback logic
• Add clear eligibility criteria in UI
• Fix redirect bug in cashback button
• Audit and correct reward engine logic
• Update UI/UX for transparency
• Communicate changes to users
• Monitor redemption and churn metrics

themes.description: Users consistently report an absence of reliable, responsive, and human‑centric customer support, citing lack of phone numbers, ineffective chatbots, and unhelpful ticketing, leading to unresolved issues and frustration.
themes.business_impact: Unresolved support escalations are causing users to miss trade opportunities, lose confidence in the platform, and ultimately churn, which directly reduces revenue and increases customer acquisition costs.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support infrastructure is under‑staffed, relies on legacy chatbot systems that cannot create tickets or connect to live agents, and lacks a dedicated phone support channel, resulting in delayed or nonexistent responses.
themes.action_plan:
• Implement a 24/7 dedicated phone support line
• Integrate ticket creation within the chatbot and ensure tickets are routed to live agents within SLA
• Add a live chat agent queue for real‑time assistance
• Train support staff on common trading issues and escalation procedures
• Deploy an internal SLA monitoring dashboard and automate alerts for response delays
• Publish a knowledge base with FAQs and troubleshooting guides
